job_description: We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience. Required skills: You must be proficient in Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Strong experience in building RESTful APIs, writing unit tests with pytest, and using Docker for containerization is required. You must have hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux system administration. Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Redis caching, message queues like RabbitMQ or Kafka, and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana is a plus. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and strong communication skills are desirable.

Looking for a Junior Backend Developer with 1 year of experience. You must have a solid understanding of Python and basic web frameworks like Flask or Django. SQL knowledge and experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL is required. Basic understanding of REST APIs and HTTP protocols is mandatory. Nice to have: Familiarity with Docker, Git version control, cloud services like AWS or GCP, and basic Linux commands is preferred but not required. Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn are beneficial.

We are looking for a Senior AI Developer with a minimum of 6 years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years focused on Machine Learning and NLP. Required: You must be proficient in Python, PyTorch, and building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LangChain and LlamaIndex. Deep expertise in vector databases like ChromaDB or Pinecone is required. You must have experience deploying models using HuggingFace and OpenAI APIs. Cloud platform experience (GCP or Azure) is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with model evaluation techniques, CI/CD for ML pipelines, TensorFlow, and excellent communication skills for collaborating with product managers is a plus.

We are looking for a Junior AI Engineer with 1 year of experience or strong academic projects in machine learning. Required: You must be comfortable writing Python scripts and have basic understanding of machine learning concepts. Experience with Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy for data preprocessing and feature engineering is required. Basic understanding of neural networks is mandatory. Nice to have: Familiarity with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch, Jupyter Notebooks, Git, SQL, and basic Linux commands is preferred. Curiosity about AI research and strong problem-solving abilities are a plus.

Seeking a Mid-Level Machine Learning Engineer with 3 years of experience building and deploying ML pipelines in production. Required: You must be proficient in Python, SQL, and developing NLP and computer vision models using PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers. Strong experience with MLOps tools including MLflow for experiment tracking is required. You must have experience with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI). Nice to have: Experience with vector databases like Pinecone or ChromaDB, DVC, Airflow for pipeline orchestration, embedding models, semantic search, and A/B testing methodologies is a plus. Ability to communicate results to non-technical stakeholders is desirable.

We are looking for a Junior DevOps Engineer with 1 year of experience to support our infrastructure team. Required: You must have basic knowledge of Linux system administration, Docker containers, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins. Writing automation scripts in Bash and Python is required. Understanding of Git workflows and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP) is mandatory. Nice to have: Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS (EC2, S3, IAM) or GCP, Nginx, log monitoring with ELK Stack, and basic security practices is preferred. Willingness to participate in on-call rotation is a plus.

Seeking a Senior Cloud Architect with 7+ years of experience designing enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure. Required: You must have deep expertise in AWS, Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions). Strong experience with cost optimization strategies, disaster recovery planning, and zero-downtime deployments is required. Knowledge of security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, and encryption is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with service mesh (Istio), event-driven systems (SNS, SQS, EventBridge), SOC2 compliance, and mentoring engineering teams is a plus. Ability to present architecture decisions to C-level executives is desirable.

Hiring a Junior Data Engineer with 1 year of experience to join our analytics team. Required: You must be able to build ETL pipelines using Python and SQL. Basic understanding of data modeling and data quality validation is required. Familiarity with Apache Airflow and data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with Git, Docker, cloud storage services like AWS S3 or GCS, dbt for data transformation, and visualization tools like Metabase or Looker is a plus. Attention to detail and good documentation habits are desirable.

We need a Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to architect our real-time data platform. Required: You must have deep expertise in Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and data warehousing with Snowflake or Databricks. Proficiency in Python, Scala, and advanced SQL is required. Experience with data lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake and orchestration with Airflow or Prefect is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with Apache Flink, data governance tools, data lineage tracking, Great Expectations for data quality, and cost optimization of cloud data workloads on AWS or GCP is a plus. Leadership experience including mentoring and sprint planning is desirable.

Looking for a Junior Mobile Developer with 1 year of experience building mobile apps. Required: You must have experience developing cross-platform applications using Flutter and Dart or React Native with TypeScript. Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and state management (Provider, Riverpod, or Redux) is required. You must know how to integrate REST APIs and implement push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging. Nice to have: Experience with local storage (SQLite or Hive), Git, app store deployment processes (Google Play and Apple App Store), and debugging with Chrome DevTools is a plus. A portfolio of published apps is desirable.

We are hiring a Senior iOS Engineer with 5+ years of experience building native iOS applications. Required: You must have deep expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, MVVM and Clean Architecture patterns, and Combine framework for reactive programming. Experience with Core Data, URLSession, and unit testing with XCTest is required. Proficiency in performance profiling with Instruments is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with Alamofire, GraphQL, CI/CD for mobile using Fastlane and Bitrise, App Store Connect submission, and accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus. Experience leading a team of iOS developers and conducting code reviews is desirable.

Hiring a Junior Security Analyst with 1 year of experience to join our SOC team. Required: You must be able to monitor security alerts using SIEM tools like Splunk or QRadar. Basic knowledge of firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, and networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) is required. Understanding of OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with vulnerability scanning tools like Nessus or OpenVAS, basic penetration testing concepts, Linux command line, Python scripting, and security frameworks like NIST or ISO 27001 is preferred. CompTIA Security+ or equivalent certification is a plus.

We are seeking a Senior Penetration Tester with 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security. Required: You must be proficient with Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, and OWASP testing methodology. Deep expertise in Active Directory attacks, privilege escalation, and writing custom Python exploits is required. OSCP, OSCE, or GPEN certification is mandatory. You must be proficient in writing detailed technical reports. Nice to have: Experience with cloud security assessments (AWS, Azure), container security (Docker, Kubernetes), mobile application testing, social engineering, and developing internal red team playbooks is a plus. Mentoring junior testers and presenting findings to executive leadership is desirable.

Hiring a Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience. Required: You must be proficient in React.js or Next.js for frontend and Node.js or Python (FastAPI/Django) for backend development. Strong experience with PostgreSQL or MongoDB, REST API design, and Git is required. Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with Docker, Redis, GraphQL, cloud deployment on AWS or Vercel, CI/CD pipelines, and WebSocket real-time communication is a plus. UI/UX design sensibility and Agile experience are desirable.

Looking for a Data Scientist with 3+ years of experience. Required: You must be proficient in Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn. Strong experience in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and building predictive models is required. Proficiency in SQL and data visualization with Matplotlib or Seaborn is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with deep learning (TensorFlow or PyTorch), NLP techniques, Spark for large-scale data processing, cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), and business intelligence tools like Tableau or Power BI is a plus. Strong storytelling skills for presenting insights to stakeholders are desirable.

Seeking an MLOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience bridging machine learning and DevOps. Required: You must have strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines for ML model deployment. Proficiency in Python, MLflow for experiment tracking, and cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI) is required. Experience with model monitoring and drift detection is mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code, Apache Airflow, feature stores like Feast, model serving with TensorFlow Serving or Triton, and GPU cluster management is a plus. Knowledge of data versioning with DVC and strong Linux skills are desirable.
